post.title: My AIs hit 99/100. I moved the hoop. They never got back
post.caption: 99 out of 100 AIs had the shot by gen 5. Then I moved the hoop and all 100 missed. Gen 9: 39. Gen 16: 79. In the 55 gens after the move, the best they ever did was 82, 17 short of 99. Every AI is a tiny neural net, and each gen the best shooters get copied with small mutations.
post.pinned: Each AI is a small neural net. Each gen the best shooters are copied with small random changes. Nobody tells them how to shoot.
